_comment: The one file you tune per project (/harness-init writes the stack bits; harness.schema.json is the field reference). A project = one-or-more components, each with its own gate, plus a cross-cutting root gate.

models._comment: Claude routes use model/fallback and effort/fallbackEffort: session Fable 5.1 medium; plan/review/evaluate Fable 5.1 high with Opus 5.5 fallback; implement Opus 5.5 high; explore/docs Haiku low. Codex role overrides are consumed by codex-setup to generate .codex/agents/*.toml even when the corresponding Claude route is primary; a native Codex session keeps its ambient model. The optional evaluator remains disabled, and one reviewer is configured. /harness-doctor check 10 validates the declared routing.

codex._comment: Global Codex CLI default for any Codex-routed phase without an override, and for generated roles without a phase override. Native Codex sessions use their ambient model and effort; these values are applied by codex-setup roles or the headless dispatcher, not the session itself. auth/timeoutSeconds are global-only.

parallel._comment: Fleet runner: opt-in parallel workers over independent tasks (declared 'files' ownership), serialized merge queue. Review bandwidth binds before compute.

gate._comment: This repo's product IS the harness, so its gate is the harness's own self-test twins. `node harness/tests/gate.mjs` is the one spelling the engine can run on both platforms (cmd /c on Windows, bash -lc on Unix) — that script explains why (a bare `bash` under cmd /c is WSL, measured) and dispatches to run-tests.ps1 + run-tests.sh. NOTE for consumer repos: an all-null gate is the shipped-template default; /harness-init fills yours from the real stack.
Cross-cutting gate, run from the repo ROOT after every component gate passes (usually just the e2e; all-null for a single-component project).

promotion._comment: Risk-gated promotion (/promote). Deterministic rules classify the diff first and can only RAISE the tier; a fresh-context risk-classifier agent then runs and can only raise it further. LOW may auto-approve + auto-merge to staging; MEDIUM/HIGH go to a human; anything matching alwaysHuman or moneySignals is HIGH unconditionally; prod is NEVER automated. Off by default — turn on deliberately, per docs/promotion.md.
